headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.77
summary: Stability fixes for behavior-pack-heavy maps, YouTube playback in mod descriptions, and the new create-world screen.

items.text: Periodic frame stutter on maps with behavior packs: removed the high-power WifiLock that forced MIUI/Android to throttle during GC.
Embedded YouTube videos in mod descriptions now play — the description WebView allows JavaScript, which the players need.
Custom dialogs no longer grow past the screen, so their buttons stay reachable.
Custom flat world is replaced with the full create-world screen.
